definition: to fall as rain from the sky
description: A short montage of outdoor moments. A big wave breaks over a wall of sand and floods a dug-out pool on the beach at sunset while people watch from the ridge; a man is washed over by the foam. Then a woman floats in a grey-green sea with raindrops hitting the water all around her. Then an empty wet road runs straight into an orange sunset over a snowy plain. Finally a woman in a white shirt and denim skirt spins barefoot and laughing on a wet mountain road in the rain, green cliffs and mist behind her.
